Name: Pet Ferrets
Author: seanstewart777
Description:
This is a revival of a project I started years ago, since my son has ferrets, and was playing Stardew quite a bit.

I recently learned how to use Content Patcher to replace audio, which was the thing that stopped me before.

Pet Ferrets replaces the all dog pet choices with ferrets. I like dogs too, but the dog animations seem to work better with the ferrets than the cat ones.

Requires SMAPI and Content Patcher to work properly.

May or may not be compatible with other pet changing mods, but I haven’t tested any of them with it.

Credit to FarmerRen on the Chucklefish forums for the portraits and animations used in this mod.
